(* REQ: LANG-361 LANG-362 LANG-363 LANG-364 LANG-365 *)
(* outer (* nested *) still a comment *)
type shape =
  | Circle of float
  | Rect of float * float

let area = function
  | Circle r -> Float.pi *. r *. r
  | Rect (w, h) -> w *. h

let rec greet name times =
  if times <= 0 then ""
  else Printf.sprintf "Hello, %s!\n" name ^ greet name (times - 1)

let id' (x : 'a) : 'a = x

module M = struct
  let quoted = {|raw "text" \n stays|}
  let c = 'x'
  let nl = '\n'
end

let () =
  let total = List.fold_left ( + ) 0 [1; 2; 3] + 0x1F + 1_000 in
  print_endline (greet "world" 2);
  Printf.printf "%d %f %b\n" total (area (Circle 1.5)) (true && not false)
